notes: Ludum Dare 59 Unity game Babushka Tower by Kettle Game Studio (https://kettle-studio.itch.io/babushka-tower; https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/59/babushka-tower). Short 3D platformer: stack objects in the grandparents' garden to catch a phone signal. Itch lists Content: No generative AI was used. Complete Unity 6000.3.13f1 project (changeset 8c4f11e4fb20) with playable scenes Assets/Scenes/Intro.unity and Assets/Scenes/Game.unity enabled in EditorBuildSettings. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2026 Kettle Game Studio; git blob 4c22765c98809284c77070879a27856a0e3b5fe4). Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json (all registry or builtin from packages.unity.com): AI Navigation 2.0.12, Collab Proxy 2.12.4, Input System 1.19.0, URP 17.3.0, Timeline 1.8.12, uGUI 2.0.0, Visual Scripting 1.9.11, test framework, IDE packages (Rider / Visual Studio), Multiplayer Center, and built-in modules. LiberationSans (SIL Open Font License 1.1, designer Steve Matteson; md5 bbbd0bdbfba093dec2ee4ca8b62e61f9) is the bundled TextMesh Pro default font; LiberationSans - OFL.txt is retained. TextMesh Pro EmojiOne sprites/asset were omitted; TMP Settings.asset m_defaultSpriteAsset was cleared and m_enableEmojiSupport was set to 0. The unused TextMesh Pro Examples & Extras folder (including Electronic Highway Sign and example OFL fonts) was omitted. Unused Unity template scene Assets/Scenes/SampleScene.unity (not in EditorBuildSettings) was omitted together with Assets/Readme.asset and Assets/_Recovery/; Settings/SampleSceneProfile.asset was retained because Mobile_RPAsset.asset and PC_RPAsset.asset reference it. Molot.otf (md5 41fd7a16df8966e172c862ca3875679f) and Molot SDF.asset were omitted: name table is Copyright (c) 2008 by Roman Yershov, Jovanny Lemonad. All rights reserved; no SPDX or redistributable license in the name table (Intro.unity and Player.prefab GUID references may remain). NGGYU_10s.mp3 (md5 d29a4cb7f8ed8b8ddee5de3a27290d4f; a short LMMS clip whose filename refers to the copyrighted song Never Gonna Give You Up) was omitted. Kevin MacLeod CC BY 3.0 music retained with attribution: Arcadia.mp3 (title Arcadia, album Scoring: Wonder, md5 2ed8c79810ec6866d8e6908e731cdb6d), merry.mp3 (title Merry Go, md5 0c0d500b257713e67b0c9264d7b74cfa), weasel.mp3 (title Scheming Weasel faster, album Scoring: Comedic, comment incompetech.com, md5 ad8f64fe300e959c10492d22d36b454d). Remaining Assets/Sounds/ SFX are credited to team member Viacheslav Ivanchenko and included under the repository MIT. 3D models, painted/photo textures, Blender sources under Blends/, and Krita/docs under Docs/ (main_image.png md5 0d5cb35233c0238d7cfafdade1f59679) are retained as team art (itch: Oleg Arutyunov 3D models; Nikole Belikova intro comic; Photos for textures: Were made by us). No DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no Library/Logs/DLL, no .DS_Store, no LFS. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. ~83M snapshot after omissions. Claim #4134. Team also: Sergey Duyunov (code), Adam Arutyunov (music stuff).
